profile.headline: IT Executive | Principal Systems Architect | VP, Sr. Technology Delivery Manager | IT Strategic Planning | Enterprise Architecture | Technology Transformation & Risk Management | Onshore/Offshore Leadership
profile.summary:
Proven senior leader with over 3 decades of experience within enterprise IT environments 
across banking, manufacturing, finance, and startups spanning various leadership roles 
including, enterprise & systems architecture, strategic planning, business process reengineering , relationship and vendor management, mission critical integrations, 
application portfolio ownership, systems development, telephony, distributed systems 
design, digital transformations, technical debt management, and risk mitigation. 

Highly skilled in transforming organizations to adopt new strategies, technologies, and 
methodologies through establishing people, process, and technology roadmaps and 
collaborating with culturally and geographically diverse teams across all phases of the 
software development life cycle.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer @ Fannie Mae via Ascendion
Principle System Architect
positions.description:
Putting people first

We’re on a mission to create financially healthy, happy homeowners. While the business of mortgages involves rates, products, dollars, and data, it's really about people. Behind every mortgage is a person, a family, a dream.

We’re here to support people at each stage of the homeownership journey—from the borrowers who represent our customer base, to the mortgage brokers and correspondent partners who count on us to help grow their businesses, to our associates who care for our all of our customers, and each other.

We believe that homeownership enriches lives and strengthens communities. Approached correctly, owning a home is about much more than just a roof over your head—it’s a crucial point in the path towards broader financial well-being.

Position Role Summary & Achievements - (Solution Architecture, Strategic Planning, Domain Transformation, Vendor Integrations, Agile Leadership, Technology Development)
 	
Responsible for leading and managing solution architecture teams, strategic planning, roadmap development, enterprise integrations, business domain transformations, vendor solutions, security/risk management, and architecture designs for SAFe Agile deliveries to build out a new Mortgage Servicing division.

Created domain architectures which included people, process, and technology roadmap analysis to allow new and evolving business domains to make informed investment decisions and realize desired target state business processes and enterprise goals.

Implemented multiple vendor software integrations and solutions that reduced cost, increased speed to market, increased security, and ensured regulatory compliance.

Hands-on development of C# solutions on Azure for process automations.

positions.title: Vice President, Sr Technology Delivery Manager/ Strategic Planning / Solution Architecture
positions.description:
Manages a team of geographically dispersed technology managers and solution engineers with on-shore and off-shore team members who are responsible for delivering technology solutions to localized lines of businesses and/or larger organizational and enterprise objectives.  Responsible for strategic plans, system solutions, and the ongoing technology support for over 100 application systems across Mortgage Servicing operational domains utilizing both Java and .Net technology platforms.

Responsible for all aspects of technology delivery including strategic planning, roadmap development, solution architecture, software delivery, and business relationship management across 20+ Home Equity and Mortgage Servicing business domains.  

Built, led, and managed both large and small diverse delivery and architecture teams across the US and India.  

Successfully led, managed, and mentored multiple Agile delivery teams through their adoption of DevOps and Scrum/Kanban methodologies on both the Microsoft Azure platform for .Net teams and the VMWare Pivotal Cloud Foundry platform for Java teams.

Successfully led and delivered a large cross-functional enterprise effort to reduce technical debt, rationalize, retire, and/or re-platform 1300+ End User Computing Tools.  Resulted in a multi-million-dollar savings and reduced the risk profile across numerous business and technology domains.

Co-led and managed the delivery and standardization of telephony solutions across US national call-center sites throughout the enterprise.

Partnered with Enterprise and Business Architecture teams to realize a Target Operating Model (TOM), created decision documents, presented borrow, buy, and build recommendations, and executed those roadmaps to propel multiple business operational domains toward their desired target states and realize cost savings.

positions.title: Technology Manager / Senior Integration Engineer
positions.description:
Manages a team of Solution Engineers who provide strategic technology planning and architecture solutions across the Default Servicing Business domains of Bankruptcy, Foreclosure, Asset Management Preservation, Real-Estate Owned, Servicing Operational Risk Management, and Third-Party Vendor Operations & Vendor Management.  Manages software delivery managers and teams with responsibilities for the Serving Operational Risk Management domain which includes a geographically dispersed organization with on-shore and off-short team members who are responsible for end to end delivery of technology solutions.

Partnered with Enterprise and Business Architecture teams to realize a Target Operating Model (TOM), created decision documents, presented borrow, buy, and build recommendations, and executed against those roadmaps to propel multiple business operational domains toward their desired target states and realize cost savings.

positions.title: Senior Integration Engineer / Strategic Planning / Solutions Architecture
positions.description: Developed a strategic integration vision, engaged, and collaborated with Technology Information Group (TIG) partners to successfully execute that vision.  Oversaw key projects initiatives, identified business process and/or systemic issues and inefficiencies, performed root cause analysis, and recommended solutions.  Acted in the highest-level technical role as an individual contributor and/or team lead for the most complex computer applications, critical systems, and mentored and assisted less technical team members.  Managed vendor relationships, roadmaps, and system integrations.
